alibabacloud-lingjun-node-diagnose 0.0.1 — Initial Release

- Provides intelligent diagnosis and repair workflow for Alibaba Cloud Lingjun (regular & hyper) GPU compute nodes.
- Supports submitting diagnostic tasks, generating structured reports, proposing repair plans, and tracking fault reports.
- Includes resource/location helpers, telemetry (syslog, hardware counters), and read-only queries.
- Enforces two-phase safe mutate for all mutating operations, with robust parameter confirmation in English/Chinese.
- Uses only the eflo-controller OpenAPI namespace; minimal plugin requirements.
